summary: Phase C testing complete — La Citadelle Numérique. All 6 tested features working correctly. Backend: 22/23 tests pass (1 skipped). Frontend: all critical flows verified via Playwright.

passed_features.details: Hero banner (Transaction Sécurisée) present at top. 'Pour les vendeurs' (fond clair) section has 5 service cards. 'Pour les acheteurs' (fond bleu nuit) section has 4 service cards. Each card has Détails + Acheter or Voir button. Total: 9 cards, 9 Détails buttons, 6 Acheter buttons.

passed_features.feature: 2. Service detail modal - Nous contacter contact form
passed_features.details: Clicking 'Détails' on 'Refonte Avant Vente' opens modal. 'Nous contacter' button opens in-app contact form (NOT email client). Contact form shows pre-filled subject 'Service : Refonte Avant Vente'. Form fields: Votre nom, Votre email, Votre demande.

Vendor login (becamarnaud@yahoo.fr) works. On step 2 of create listing form, clicking price field triggers commission popup showing 5% rate and 49€ minimum. 'J'ai compris — Fixer mon prix' button dismisses popup correctly.

Admin login via /connexion works. /syndicat-admin/citadelle/commission page loads correctly. Changed rate to 7% and minimum to 60€, saved with 'Enregistré !' success message shown on button. Reset to 5%/49€ confirmed via API (GET /api/citadelle/settings/commission returns rate=0.05, minimum_eur=49).

Sending message 'mon email est testui@example.com, appelez-moi' displays as 'mon email est [contact masqué par La Citadelle], appelez-moi' in chat. Orange warning banner shows: 'Certaines informations de contact ont été masquées afin de maintenir les échanges sur La Citadelle.' API returns sanitized=true.
Returns {rate: 0.05, minimum_eur: 49}. Endpoint is public (no auth required). Rate is a decimal (0.05 = 5%). Update via admin PUT and read-back via GET both work correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In admin commission test, the success 'Enregistré !' label auto-resets after 3s (setTimeout). This is by design but verify it's visible to admin in real usage.
INFO: Vendeur admin login is via /connexion (main Syndicat portal), not /syndicat-admin/login (which doesn't exist). This is correct per the auth architecture.

INFO: The commission popup shows values fetched dynamically from API (citadelleApi.get('/settings/commission')). If API is slow, falls back to COMMISSION_RATE/COMMISSION_MINIMUM_EUR constants — robust design.

Minor observation: Message sanitizer test via Playwright sends as vendeur in their own conversation (vendeur is the seller). The API correctly allows seller to reply. The sanitizer correctly works for both buyer and seller messages.

success_rate.backend: 96% (22/23 tests, 1 skipped due to needing acheteur→vendeur listing setup)

seed_data_creation: Sent test messages with emails to conversation e50431d2-6e4c-45bc-a054-8567bf956cec (vendeur's existing conversation). These messages contain '[contact masqué par La Citadelle]' as they were sanitized.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase C tested. All 6 features work: Services page, Contact form modal, Commission popup, Admin commission settings, Message sanitizer, Commission API. Admin login uses /connexion (not /syndicat-admin/login which is blank). Commission correctly resets to 5%/49€. Vendeur has 2 existing conversations on listing 'test vente site 2'. The previous issue from iteration_1 (CITADELLE_CATEGORIES slugs mismatch) may still need retesting if main agent fixed it.
